title.purpose: Panel titles and the wordmark; the largest type in the room.

caption.purpose: Row descriptions, hints, and banner copy in ink-3.

label.purpose: Uppercase mono section labels; lowercase mono for URLs, hosts, workspace names, key placeholders.

panel-title.purpose: Takeover and full-screen moment headings (quit confirm, update ready, welcome). Largest type in the popover.

body-small.purpose: Takeover body copy and inline action links (Replace key, Sign out, Cancel).

shadows.name: seam
shadows.value: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.165 0 0) 6%, transparent), 0 1px 0 0 color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.165 0 0) 6%, transparent), 0 2px 4px -1px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.165 0 0) 4%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Resting edge of every card, input, and secondary button (shadow-border). The shadow stack IS the border.

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Primary action; Gate Indigo fill deepening on hover, no shadow theatrics.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; height: 40px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 16px; background: #3e4fea; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: #2a38cb; } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3e4fea; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-accent:disabled { opacity: 0.45; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White surface wearing the Seam; hover raises seam contrast.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; height: 40px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 16px; background: #ffffff; color: #0f1222; font-family: 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.165 0 0) 6%, transparent), 0 1px 0 0 color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.165 0 0) 6%, transparent), 0 2px 4px -1px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.165 0 0) 4%, transparent); transition: box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover, .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.165 0 0) 9%, transparent), 0 1px 0 0 color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.165 0 0) 8%, transparent), 0 2px 6px -1px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.165 0 0) 6%, transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3e4fea; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Switch
components.description: 38x22 pill toggle; indigo when on, thumb carries a check so state reads without color.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; display: inline-flex; height: 22px; width: 38px; align-items: center; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: #3e4fea; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-switch[aria-checked="false"] { background: #d4d7e3; } .ds-switch-thumb { position: absolute; display: flex; height: 18px; width: 18px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 9999px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(10,10,10,0.15); transform: translateX(18px); transition: transform 150ms; } .ds-switch[aria-checked="false"] .ds-switch-thumb { transform: translateX(2px); } .ds-switch[aria-checked="false"] .ds-switch-thumb svg { display: none; } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3e4fea; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Connection Pill
components.description: Truthful system state in a capsule: wash background, solid dot, deep text.
components.css: .ds-pill-connected { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 48px; background: rgba(46,204,113,0.14); padding: 4px 8px; color: #177a42; font-family: 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-pill-dot { height: 6px; width: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #2ecc71; }

components.name: Feature Card Row

components.css: .ds-card-row { display: flex; width: 100%; max-width: 332px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-radius: 10px; background: #ffffff; padding: 14px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.165 0 0) 6%, transparent), 0 1px 0 0 color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.165 0 0) 6%, transparent), 0 2px 4px -1px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.165 0 0) 4%, transparent); transition: box-shadow 150ms; font-family: 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-row:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.165 0 0) 9%, transparent), 0 1px 0 0 color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.165 0 0) 8%, transparent), 0 2px 6px -1px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.165 0 0) 6%, transparent); } .ds-card-tile { display: flex; height: 36px; width: 36px; flex-shrink: 0; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 9px; background: rgba(62,79,234,0.08); color: #3e4fea; } .ds-card-body { min-width: 0; flex: 1; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #0f1222; } .ds-card-caption { margin-top: 2px; font-size: 11.5px; color: #55596f; } .ds-card-chevron { flex-shrink: 0; color: #7a7f93; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Seam-edged field; focus raises the seam, no glow or accent ring.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { display: flex; height: 36px; width: 100%; max-width: 332px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: #ffffff; padding: 0 12px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.165 0 0) 6%, transparent), 0 1px 0 0 color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.165 0 0) 6%, transparent), 0 2px 4px -1px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.165 0 0) 4%, transparent); transition: box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input-wrap:focus-within { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.165 0 0) 9%, transparent), 0 1px 0 0 color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.165 0 0) 8%, transparent), 0 2px 6px -1px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.165 0 0) 6%, transparent); } .ds-input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: none; background: transparent; font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 13px; color: #0f1222; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7a7f93; }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: The ledger's column headings: uppercase mono micro-labels.
components.css: .ds-section-label { padding: 12px 14px 6px; font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #7a7f93; }

components.description: Signature truth-telling: warm highlight banner when routing state and running apps disagree.

components.css: .ds-hint-banner { display: flex; width: 100%; max-width: 332px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border-radius: 6px; background: #f6ffe3; padding: 10px 12px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.165 0 0) 6%, transparent), 0 1px 0 0 color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.165 0 0) 6%, transparent), 0 2px 4px -1px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.165 0 0) 4%, transparent); font-family: 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-hint-banner svg { flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-hint-text { min-width: 0; flex: 1; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.35; color: #0f1222; } .ds-hint-text strong { font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
Gate Connect is a small warm room at the edge of something big. A calm keeper checks your credentials, waves your traffic through, and keeps the key on its hook where you can see it. The popover (360px wide, ~520px tall) is that one room: white paper surfaces, a ledger's precision in the mono identifiers, and a single house color (Gate Indigo) that marks what is live and actionable. The emotional target is the reassuring gatekeeper: the user should close the popover thinking "good, that's handled."

The system is ink-on-paper carried by shadows instead of lines. Elevated surfaces (cards, inputs, buttons) never wear a solid 1px border; a three-stop shadow stack draws their seam. Hairline borders exist only as structural dividers between the popover's fixed zones. Controls are quiet and precise: state changes are legible, never theatrical, and every status pill reports system state truthfully.
keyCharacteristics: One room: everything fits a 360px popover; panels slide, nothing stacks.
Shadow-as-border seams on every elevated surface.
Gate Indigo marks affordance and live state; neutrals do everything else.
Geist for voice, Geist Mono for identity and system state.
Quiet, precise controls; reassurance through transparency.

rules.name: The Provisional Indigo Rule
rules.body: The Gate Indigo palette is the incumbent identity of this popover (from the Claude Design handoff) but it is provisional. The wider Constellation Gate family rule is ink-primary, never blue, and a future pass may fold the popover back to it. Extend the existing indigo usage patterns faithfully; do not invent new indigo surface types, and do not bleed the gc-* palette into shared cg components.

rules.name: The Wash-First Rule
rules.body: Status and accent colors touch surfaces only as washes (8 to 14% alpha) with a solid dot or text in the full color. Solid accent fills are reserved for the primary button and the switch on-state.

rules.name: The Mono Earns Its Place Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono appears only where identity or precision matters: URLs, hosts, API key placeholders, workspace names, section labels, status identifiers, tabular counts. Body copy, labels on buttons, and descriptions are always sans. Mono is a signal, not a vibe.

rules.name: The One Room Rule
rules.body: Every screen works inside the 360px frame without scrolling chrome. If a design needs a second window or a stacked modal, it is the wrong design.

rules.name: The Seam Rule
rules.body: Elevated surfaces never wear a solid 1px border; the seam stack draws their edge. Hairline borders (line, #e8eaef) are permitted only as structural dividers between the popover's fixed zones (header/footer separators), never around cards, inputs, or buttons.

dos: Do draw every card, input, and secondary button edge with the Seam stack (shadow-border), moving to Seam Hover on hover/focus-within.
Do keep Gate Indigo scoped to affordance and live state: primary buttons, switch on-states, active icon tiles, links.
Do set identifiers (URLs, hosts, workspace names, key placeholders, section labels) in Geist Mono at 10.5 to 11px; keep pills' text sans.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion for every animation; the global collapse in index.css is the contract.
Do keep every screen inside the 360px popover; secondary surfaces slide as full panels with the 260ms directional grammar.
Do meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast on white; ink-3 (#55596f) is the floor for body-secondary text.
donts: Don't put a solid 1px border on a card, input, or button; hairlines are for the popover's fixed structural seams only.
Don't introduce new indigo surface types or leak the gc-* palette into shared cg components (The Provisional Indigo Rule).
Don't use gradients, neon accents, sparkles, or dark chrome; the generic AI aesthetic is a locked anti-reference.
Don't set body copy or button labels in mono, or use all-caps outside the 10.5px mono section labels.
Don't stack modals or open second windows; one room, sliding panels.
Don't use the em dash character anywhere in UI copy.
